Safe maintained parsing adds no unsafe boundary; 27 new dependency sources/licenses were independently checked. Independent source/native review, full ordinary protected checks and exact hosted 41182139272 all passed. Downloaded artifact 13034934766 matches all 128 source inputs; JSON/LCOV recomputation confirms strict owned coverage and 68/68 changed executable lines. The 64 KiB input and combined-capacity limits are explicit differences from native unbounded storage. No new original credit, global identity, multihost, CLI or performance claim; statistics policy remains held. The next private slice preserves PubSubLargeMessageAboveShmThreshold: exact 256 KiB Bytes length/content, the original 2500 ms wait, unchanged native publisher and reverse Rust publication schedule. Author debug two, release two and unchanged native original one pass; all 42 tools, formatting and workspace Clippy pass. No production change or SHM-path identity claim. The six-path packet awaits independent review and full staged/hosted qualification; no ledger disposition has changed.
